heroHeadline: Day 951: Triple Accountability Revelation Week — Civil Commission Report, Inquiry Bill Whitewash, and IDF Footage Deletion Allegation — Unifies Opposition as 47-Day Supreme Court Deadline Approaches
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. In the week of May 12–15, 2026 (Days 948–951), three successive accountability developments have hardened Israel's October 7 political crisis: May 12 (Day 948) — the Civil Commission on October 7th Crimes by Hamas published its two-year 'Silenced No More' final report, documenting that sexual violence was 'systematic, widespread, and integral' to Hamas strategy, including newly disclosed abuse of minors, based on 10,000+ images/videos and 430+ testimonies; on the same day, the Knesset passed a military tribunal law (93-0) to try ~300 captured October 7 perpetrators, with genocide convictions carrying the death penalty and those convicted barred from future prisoner exchanges. May 13 (Day 949) — Knesset committee meetings revealed that MK Ariel Kallner (Likud) had quietly removed 'full, thorough, and independent investigation' from the coalition's inquiry bill purpose clause; separately, the bill also contains a 'no judges' provision barring Supreme Court justices, former Shin Bet chiefs, and senior jurists from serving on the commission; October Council declared the bill a 'political whitewash.' May 14 (Day 950) — IDF accused by Israel Hayom and Middle East Monitor of secretly seizing and partially deleting October 7 security camera footage from Kibbutz Be'eri; opposition demands full accounting of all evidence collected from Gaza Envelope communities. May 15 (Day 951) — JPPI poll finds 63% of Israelis support an immediate October 7 commission of inquiry; 47 days remain to the Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 deadline for the government to present a 'suitable' investigation framework. The Netanyahu government is advancing the Kallner bill toward a first plenum reading in late May despite its exclusion of judicial independence; opposition parties have vowed a coordinated Knesset walkout and emergency Supreme Court challenge. Hamas's 1,195-death attack of October 7, 2023 — which triggered 251 hostage-takings (all accounted for as of January 26, 2026) and Operation Swords of Iron — remains the unresolved accountability wound at the heart of Israeli politics. Gaza ceasefire remains highly volatile: Israel controls 60%+ of Gaza, Hamas holds firm on disarmament refusal, 850+ Palestinians killed since October 2025 ceasefire, IDF operational plans for resumed offensive complete pending US authorization.
